readability.reason: Sentences are plain and most terms are glossed on first use, and the Timeline's 'Does this match?' framing works. Against that: 36 points recur in 3+ sections (the same Mars/Moon/Mercury/Jupiter dignity facts are re-explained almost everywhere); the glance uses visible routing wording ('Personality covers the Sun, and Spirituality covers the twelfth house', 'Health covers Rahu'); author-citation density is high (Raman, Braha, Rath, Frawley, Foss, Trivedi, Murthy, B.S. Rao, PanchangBodh); a few writer instructions leak ('Advise rest toward its end', 'avoid any reading about having or not having children', 'Old trade lists are best translated into modern families of work'); 'wife' appears for a female native; and the Timeline has no visible tables, so 3,000+ words of dated prose are hard to scan.
